summary: Independent verification of the fail-closed disposable-database isolation implementation. Read preview MongoDB counts directly via /app/backend/.env values before any test invocation and saved the exact baseline (audit_trail 9128, auth_sessions 2604, batches 724, customers 15, instruments 74, login_attempts 0, oos_log 104, parameters 226, products 99, sample_points 324, samples 452, spec_versions 138, specifications 415, users 308) - identical to the baseline the main agent captured. Focused isolation suite: `python /app/scripts/run_isolated_backend_tests.py tests/test_database_isolation.py` resolved ISOLATED_TEST_DB=test_database_test_bb006c69230341e78c10c60a5fec0ba4 (matches ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,47}_test_[a-f0-9]{12,32}$, differs from preview `test_database`), ISOLATED_TEST_SERVER=http://127.0.0.1:41249 (loopback, non-preview port reserved via reserve_test_port), seed_test_accounts.py created admin@lims.local/qa@lims.local/qc@lims.local in the disposable DB only, pytest 7/7 passed in 1.57s, PREVIEW_COUNTS_AFTER identical to PREVIEW_COUNTS_BEFORE, PREVIEW_COUNTS_UNCHANGED=True, DISPOSABLE_DATABASE_REMOVED=True. Full suite: `python /app/scripts/run_isolated_backend_tests.py tests` resolved a fresh, different ISOLATED_TEST_DB=test_database_test_563aede511514efb8344fc53832d1572 on port 42941, 216 passed in 63.27s (only two PytestRemovedIn10Warning notices about class-scoped instance-method fixtures - non-blocking upstream deprecation), PREVIEW_COUNTS_AFTER identical, PREVIEW_COUNTS_UNCHANGED=True, DISPOSABLE_DATABASE_REMOVED=True. Post-run verification against MongoDB confirmed: (a) all 14 preview collection counts unchanged from baseline, (b) `client.list_database_names()` returns only ['admin','config','local','test_database'] - zero databases containing '_test_' remain, (c) samples.find_one({'record_id':'REC-20260908-0201'}) still resolves. Reviewed the source: test_isolation.validate_test_database_name refuses blank names, preview-equal names, and any candidate lacking `_test_` or failing the strict regex; make_disposable_database_name double-validates the generated candidate; drop_disposable_database re-validates before any client.drop_database call, so a corrupted or spoofed name cannot destroy preview; conftest.py sets DB_NAME to the disposable name before importing database.py so no module-level connection can bind to preview; run_isolated_backend_tests.py reads MONGO_URL and DB_NAME from backend/.env, generates a unique run id and DB per run, and drops the disposable DB in a finally block regardless of pytest exit code. No source files modified. No preview writes performed at any point (Mongo access limited to count_documents/find_one/list_database_names).
critical_code_review_comments: test_isolation.IsolatedTestServer.start() suppresses uvicorn stdout/stderr via subprocess.DEVNULL. If the isolated server fails to become healthy the runner only reports 'did not become healthy' with no stack trace, making triage harder. Consider tee-ing to a per-run log file under /tmp so future failures are debuggable without weakening isolation.

run_isolated_backend_tests.py runs seed_test_accounts.py in a subprocess with LIMS_ENABLE_TEST_ACCOUNTS=true but does not assert that the seeded users landed in the disposable DB (only that the script exits 0). A stronger guarantee would be to count users in the disposable DB after seeding and refuse to continue if the count is zero, closing the door on a future regression where seed silently targets a different DB.

conftest.py raises DatabaseSafetyError at import time when LIMS_TEST_SERVER_PORT/LIMS_TEST_RUN_ID/MONGO_URL are missing, which correctly blocks bare `pytest`. However `pytest.ini` sets `required_plugins = pytest-xdist` and `-n 0`; a developer running pytest with `-n auto` (multi-worker) is not blocked by anything except the missing env vars. Consider also validating that LIMS_TEST_DB_NAME is present as a plugin-level check in a pytest_configure hook so the failure message is clearer than a raw import-time RuntimeError.

drop_disposable_database uses client.drop_database directly against the MongoClient passed in; in the fixture teardown path (conftest.py line 58) the `client` used is imported from `database.py`, which was constructed with the disposable DB name. That is safe today because validate_test_database_name is re-checked, but relies on the invariant that database.py's module-level MongoClient uses the same MONGO_URL as the preview. A defense-in-depth improvement would be to always instantiate a fresh MongoClient(MONGO_URL) inside drop_disposable_database rather than accepting an arbitrary client.

Two PytestRemovedIn10Warning warnings originate from class-scoped instance-method fixtures in tests/backend_test.py (TestWorkflow) and tests/test_oos_disposition.py (TestMineralAcceptanceScenario). Not blocking today, but will break on pytest 10. Convert those fixtures to @classmethod or module-level to future-proof.
test_credentials: Not used against preview. Isolated runner seeded admin@lims.local/Admin@123, qa@lims.local/Qa@12345, qc@lims.local/Qc@12345 into the disposable database only.
seed_data_creation: None in preview. Each run of the isolated runner seeded the three lims.local accounts into its disposable database, which was dropped in the finally block. Verified post-run that no databases containing '_test_' remain and preview `users` count stayed at 308.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The isolated runner is the only sanctioned entry point for backend tests: `python /app/scripts/run_isolated_backend_tests.py [pytest_args]`. Bare `pytest` fails at collection because conftest.py demands LIMS_TEST_SERVER_PORT/LIMS_TEST_RUN_ID/LIMS_TEST_DB_NAME, and any test DB name that equals preview or lacks the `_test_` marker triggers DatabaseSafetyError. To assert preview integrity, capture collection counts from MongoClient(os.environ['MONGO_URL'])[os.environ['DB_NAME']] before and after the runner and diff them; the runner also prints PREVIEW_COUNTS_BEFORE/PREVIEW_COUNTS_AFTER/PREVIEW_COUNTS_UNCHANGED/DISPOSABLE_DATABASE_REMOVED for cross-check. Never invoke scripts/seed_test_accounts.py directly - it is delegated to by the runner with the disposable DB in scope. REC-20260908-0201 remains a good preview canary.
rca of the issue: No defect. Isolation implementation is sound: validate_test_database_name(strict regex + preview-equality refusal + blank refusal) is the single choke point used by make_disposable_database_name, conftest.py session fixture, drop_disposable_database, and the regression tests in test_database_isolation.py. Both isolated runs produced fresh disposable DB names, disposable server on 127.0.0.1 non-preview ports, preview counts unchanged, disposable DB removed. Full 216-test suite plus focused 7-test suite both green. REC-20260908-0201 intact.
